title: REQ · Dust, ambient lighting and scene transitions are content-driven
summary: Scene content declares effects and goto_scene triggers a fade transition.
description: Context: sceneSchema has no effects field and nothing animates scene changes though the typed bus has transitionTo and the manifest holds effects/dust.svg. Desired behavior: add an optional effects array (types dust and ambientLight) to the scene schema, create effect entities on the effects layer, and run a fade-out, swap, fade-in transition. Expected: adding an effect or scene is a content edit. Why: atmosphere and scene changes without engine rewrites.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with effects [{type:'dust'}], when built, then particles are added at the effects depth
Given {type:'ambientLight',color,alpha}, when built, then an overlay with that color and alpha is added
Given a scene without effects, when parsed, then effects defaults to an empty list and parsing still succeeds
Given a transition request, when run, then fade out is called, then the swap callback, then fade in, in that order

preserve: Existing scene parsing results for scenes without effects

technical_constraints: Effects use the dust asset id from the manifest
definition_of_done: Effects and transition wired in WorldScene
